title: The First Internet Connections
summary: Imran-Net launches Pakistan's first commercial dial-up service; SDNPK begins reliable email access. By 1998, speeds reach 56kbps.

title: Submarine Cables & DSL
summary: PTCL brings Pakistan's first submarine cable (SEA-ME-WE-3) online; DSL broadband launches in 2002; the 2004 De-regulation Policy opens the market.

title: Facebook & YouTube Blocked
summary: Facebook, YouTube, Wikipedia, and Flickr are banned over a controversial page, lifted after roughly a week.

title: Three Years Offline
summary: YouTube is blocked nationwide alongside ~20,000 other sites after the 'Innocence of Muslims' film; access is restored in January 2016.

title: 3G/4G Auction
summary: Pakistan's first spectrum auction raises $1.1 billion; Zong, Mobilink, Telenor, and Ufone launch 3G/4G services nationwide.

title: PECA Enacted
summary: The Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act gives the PTA formal legal power to block and remove online content.

title: Digital Pakistan Policy
summary: Government policy targets a $20 billion ICT industry by 2025, laying groundwork for the freelancing and startup boom.

title: First 5G Tests in South Asia
summary: Pakistan becomes the first South Asian country to test 5G mobile network services.

title: TikTok Banned
summary: TikTok is banned nationwide over 'immoral content', part of a wider pattern of platform-specific restrictions.

title: Nationwide Internet Blackout
summary: Mobile internet and phone services are suspended nationwide on general election day; X (Twitter) is banned days later.

title: $3.2 Billion in IT Exports
summary: IT and IT-enabled services exports cross $3.2 billion in FY2023-24, with Pakistan ranking among the world's top 5 freelancing markets.
